title: About AeroGraph
intro: AeroGraph is an open-source command-line tool for keeping project knowledge connected.

choices.title: Local to your project
choices.body: Knowledge is stored locally in SQLite, with no hosted account required. Starting with a command-line tool makes it possible to use project context directly in coding workflows.
choices.tradeoff: Shared cloud workspaces are not part of the current offering.

choices.title: Connections you control
choices.body: People and agents record notes and link them to relevant code and work. Explicit connections make the reasoning inspectable rather than asking you to trust inferred relationships.
choices.tradeoff: Those notes and links need upkeep; AeroGraph does not infer them from your code.

choices.title: Context, not orchestration
choices.body: Export context as Markdown for your coding agent. Keeping knowledge separate from execution lets the same context support different agents and workflows.
choices.tradeoff: Your agent handles execution and review.

status: Interfaces are evolving. The repository has setup instructions and current usage.
